svg.title: Prompt injection through tool output
svg.desc: <g font-family="DejaVu Sans, sans-serif"> <rect x="64" y="154" width="302" height="360" fill="#dbe7e5"/><text x="96" y="208" fill="#17222d" font-size="25" font-weight="700">UNTRUSTED</text><text x="96" y="250" fill="#6c7478" font-size="18">page · email · API</text><path d="M96 306H326M96 350H286M96 394H316" stroke="#6c7478" stroke-width="9"/><path d="M96 452H300" stroke="#d9572b" stroke-width="9"/> <path d="M366 334H500" stroke="#17222d" stroke-width="4"/><path d="m482 320 24 14-24 14" fill="none" stroke="#17222d" stroke-width="4"/> <rect x="520" y="120" width="322" height="428" fill="#17222d"/><text x="562" y="198" fill="#f3f1eb" font-size="27" font-weight="700">POLICY GATE</text><text x="562" y="256" fill="#dbe7e5" font-size="18">data != instruction</text><text x="562" y="304" fill="#dbe7e5" font-size="18">capabilities = []</text><rect x="562" y="360" width="236" height="78" fill="#d9572b"/><text x="606" y="409" fill="#f3f1eb" font-size="24" font-weight="700">DENY</text> <path d="M842 334H974" stroke="#17222d" stroke-width="4"/><path d="m956 320 24 14-24 14" fill="none" stroke="#17222d" stroke-width="4"/> <rect x="994" y="210" width="222" height="248" fill="none" stroke="#17222d" stroke-width="3"/><text x="1026" y="278" fill="#17222d" font-size="24" font-weight="700">ACTION</text><path d="M1026 326H1182" stroke="#6c7478" stroke-width="8"/><path d="M1026 370H1136" stroke="#6c7478" stroke-width="8"/><path d="M1026 414H1170" stroke="#6c7478" stroke-width="8"/> </g>
